settings.sample_rule: the manifest order, which the corpus builder sorted by the digest of the path

memory_scope.included: nothing: this measurement reports bytes moved and decode times, not process memory
memory_scope.excluded: the process working set of the driver, of the Node process and of the native bench

timing_scope.native_memory: the region decode through RangeReader over bytes already in memory, timed in-process; the container is read from disk outside the measurement
timing_scope.native_file: the region decode through RangeReader over the file on disk, timed in-process; the disk read is inside the measurement
timing_scope.wasm_whole: the copy of the container into the module's memory plus the region decode, timed in-process; the file read from disk is outside the measurement
timing_scope.wasm_range: the open from the header and the directory plus the fetch of the tiles the viewport touches plus the decode, timed in-process; the bytes are fetched from an in-process slice, not from a network
